limits: No browser viewport/200%-zoom/keyboard/camera observation was made in this execution (NOT_RUN); layout is build- and typecheck-verified only.

Interactive NEAR wallet connect/sign/deposit (mobile return, real wallet) is NOT_RUN — needs a consenting human wallet. The exact NEAR Connect transaction actions (FT storage_deposit, ShowStake storage_deposit, ft_transfer_call) are unit-verified for their NEP shapes; the live wallet click/broadcast is Codex/human's scoped action, never this worker's.

HOT's testnet capability is ABSENT/UNPROVEN in the shared @hot-labs/near-connect manifest (a known, documented decision), not an inferred incapability; the connector surfaces only wallets that declare testnet support.

NEAR Connect (@hot-labs/near-connect@0.12.0) drives connect/sign and user-approved signAndSendTransaction via JSON-safe ConnectorActions; near-api-js@7.4.0 remains the canonical server-side NEP-413 verifier (packages/wallet-adapter + onboarding probe) and is intentionally NOT bundled into the browser — this slice never verifies an ed25519 signature itself.

The accepted live event d036-settle-five is Settled, so the detail route truthfully shows finished/settlement/claim outcomes and registration is closed; the storage/deposit approval flow is only exercisable against a future accepted open event (no fixture catalogue).

A positive native storage credit is never treated as sufficient, an unknown reserved-count is never defaulted to 0, the chain clock/phase is re-read before commit, and an unknown submission is never auto-retried or auto re-deposited.

The API is reached same-origin via a closed Next rewrite (single upstream, /v1 prefix); the API projection's chain event id is absent, so accepted deployments are resolved read-only via the contract list_events (API owner=Codex).

This provenance records only apps/web + frontend verification scripts; apps/api, apps/worker, packages/domain, packages/wallet-adapter, Rust and the root package.json/pnpm-lock remain untouched by this writer.
